decisions.reason: Amazon's 0.90-inch spine specification does not change the required title style or the panels that must match the front-cover typography.
The platform-specific spine width does not alter the existing requirement to reflow the trimmed blurb and prevent overlap with the back-cover barcode.
The Amazon spine-width specification does not change the required layered PSD, PDF, and JPG deliverable formats.
Applying Amazon's platform-specific spine width does not revoke or modify the constraint to preserve the existing design and avoid an unrelated redesign.
